objective.text: Use stable morph aliases instead of coupling persisted types to PHP class names.

difficulty.rationale: Decouple stored polymorphic identity from PHP namespace changes while planning existing-data migration.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A commentable_type column currently stores PHP class names. The team expects to move model namespaces without rewriting historical rows on each move. Which design provides a stable boundary, including the initial transition?

options.text: Rename the PHP classes and leave all stored type strings and mappings untouched.
options.rationale: Historical class-name values still refer to the old names unless compatibility or migration is provided.
options.misconception: Historical class-name values still refer to the old names unless compatibility or migration is provided.

options.text: Store only commentable_id and infer the model type from the numeric range.
options.rationale: Different target tables may share identifiers, so this loses explicit polymorphic identity.
options.misconception: Different target tables may share identifiers, so this loses explicit polymorphic identity.

options.text: Define stable morph aliases, migrate existing type values to those aliases, and enforce the map.
options.rationale: Stored aliases remain stable while the application map points them to current classes; old class-name rows need an intentional transition.

options.text: Add a serialization accessor for commentable_type but leave the relation mapping unchanged.
options.rationale: Presentation-only transformation does not establish the persisted-type resolution contract.
options.misconception: Presentation-only transformation does not establish the persisted-type resolution contract.
